pains.title: Regression automation hits three walls
pains.subtitle: Scripts break when the page changes, agents drift when the context shifts, coverage lags once releases speed up.

items.title: Recorded scripts break on every change
items.desc: Traditional recordings bind to page structure and locators, so a single version change invalidates whole batches of cases. Repairing them often takes longer than re-recording.

items.title: Intent-driven testing: slow and unpredictable
items.desc: Having an agent reason through every step is slow and token-heavy — and the same case can behave differently under a different model or context.

items.title: AI coding accelerates; coverage lags behind
items.desc: Commit frequency is multiplying, but test assets still update by hand — impact never assessed, changes never covered, so regression stays a blind run.
